blocks.text: The Audit Log page tracks any changes users make inside AI Guard. This can range from anything from updating a policy control to signing in.
To view the AI Guard Audit Log page:

blocks.item: Go to AI Security Admin Portal > AI Guard > Audit Log.
See image.
The Audit Log page allows you to view the following information:
Date Range: Select the date range you want to see the logs for.
Refresh: Update the audit log.
Export CSV: Download a CSV file of the filtered audit log.
Timestamp: The date and time that an action was logged.
Initiator: The email address of the user that triggered the action.
Click the Search button in the header to search for a specific initiator.
Action: The action performed, such as: Update, View, or Create.
Click the Filter button in the header to select which actions you want to see.
Entity Type: More granular detail about the action. For example, an Action of Update may have an Entity Type of Policy Control, meaning that the user made an update to a policy control.
Click the Filter button in the header to select which entity types you want to see.
For more information about the logged event, in the Details column, click the View Request Details button.
See image.
The Actions Details window shows the following information:
Initiator, Action, and Entity Type: The same information from the main Audit Log page.
Entity ID: The ID number associated with the action.

Changes: A field-by-field table that shows any changes from a specific log. Nested fields are a single level deep, anything further is shown as an object or array placeholder. Only relevant changes are shown, noise (such as id or lastUpdatedAt fields) that are empty of changes are hidden.
Advanced: View the full JSON code changes.
Revert: This undoes Create, Update, or Delete on all supported detectors. It will ask for confirmation before reverting the changes.
